<b>Kais</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are plump floaters that once teemed around the [[Coral Tower]] in immense numbers.<ref>Kai Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"They once teemed around their tower, in numbers immense. It is a rare chance to witness such a bountiful display of life."</i></ref>  Long lost to time, they live on only in memory. 

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Kais float gently through the air, turning around once they reach a wall. If Hornet gets near,  they dash a short distance at her, mainly horizontally.
Kais deal {{Damage|1}} of contact damage.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* The crust covers...
* The crust conceals...
* Our shells made strong...
* Our nest made secret...
}}

== Location ==
Kais can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
